queue.title: This Design Pattern Replaces an Entire Class Hierarchy
queue.description:
🧱 Build software that lasts. Join the Software Design Mastery program → https://arjan.codes/mastery.

What should you do when objects differ by type: create subclasses, store an enum like plan_type, or represent each variation as an object? In this video, I use a realistic Python subscription system to compare all three approaches and introduce the Type Object pattern.

queue.editorial_reason: Compares subclasses, enums and objects-as-data in a realistic Python example; durable design lesson.
